description_for_human: Query open Dynamics 365 Customer Service cases and propose next best actions.
description_for_model: Use this plugin whenever the user asks to retrieve, filter, or summarize open customer service cases from Microsoft Dataverse / Dynamics 365 Customer Service, or when the user asks to record a proposed next action on a specific case ID.

functions.name: getOpenServiceCases
functions.description: Retrieves open customer service cases from Microsoft Dataverse filtered by priority and account name, honoring the signed-in user's On-Behalf-Of (OBO) security permissions.

functions.name: proposeCaseNextAction
functions.description: Writes a proposed next-best-action recommendation and resolution note onto an existing service case in Microsoft Dataverse. Requires explicit user confirmation.

confirmation.title: Confirm Case Update in Dynamics 365
confirmation.body: Are you sure you want to record this proposed next action on the Dynamics 365 Customer Service case?
